answer: A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to peer-prediction scoring that pays graders for accuracy against the panel, making lazy grading unprofitable. Attesting costs a reef of attention per epoch, and a forged garden collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Bright as a ember in fog, verified work is hard to counterfeit. A clone inherits a wallet, never a work history, and history is the only currency that matters.
